title: Uncrossed Lines
summary: Given two integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, write their integers on two horizontal lines.
statement: Given two integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, write their integers on two horizontal lines. Draw lines connecting equal numbers from each array without intersection, ensuring no endpoints overlap. Return the maximum number of such non-intersecting lines.
constraints: Lines connect equal values and cannot cross or reuse endpoints.
hints: Noncrossing connections preserve index order, exactly the longest common subsequence condition.
Use one DP row and retain the prior diagonal value.
On equality take diagonal+1; otherwise take the larger top/left state.
The final state exhausts matching or skipping each pair of prefixes.
editorial: The final state exhausts matching or skipping each pair of prefixes.

tests.explanation: Choose matches for one and either four or two, giving two lines.
An order-preserving set of three equal matches is possible.
